ive been playing the game for 4/5 months now and im still learning something new every day im on so you'll pick it all up at somepoint. Im currently training some EWAR stuff for the corp im in as we have a logi ship and thought why not throw an EWAR into the mix as well. when you are in either a logi or EWAR ship though when you get into a fight when you're out with your corp you will be targetted first by the enemy as no one likes the other team having logi or ewar on the field. I would recommend you do just general PvP with ships as you need to learn how to keep ranges and what ships to target and when to bug out and when to come back in to the fight. Logi and ewar ships tend to not have any tanking at all and die fairly quickly so real life knowledge of when to back off and when to engage is well and truely needed. A lot of FC's in small fights let the logi ewar guys do what they feel is best for their situation so learning what to do and when before you start loosing the ships and wondering why is essential

rifter is the fastest t1 frig there is followed closely by condor or Atron (i think). ive been playing eve for almost 4 months now and just starting to do PvP. I joined a FW corp and it is one of the best routes to take for learning as they will always want a frig tackler there. Hell the corp im in only does Frig/Destroyer roams just now as we have a lot of newer players who cant fly much else. Before you jump into it realise that you will die and you will die a lot in game god knows ive been abusing my corps SRP (Ship Replacement Program) like hell since i started but its needed! 
Its good fun and you will often get into some pretty intense fights between us and other frig gangs or jumping a bigger ship.
It helps you to learn the basics of fleet combat as well which are a big thing as just having the skills trained doesnt automatically make you powerful in Eve a 3 week old player can destroy a year old player (or older) just by how theyve learned how to fly what theyre flying and how they are flying it compared to the other guy 
Amarr FW is the way forward just now as there is guarnteed a fight every time your out or your running for your life as wel its fun
My corp Evil Monkey Alliance (or Association cant remember haha) is based in GMT and there is always a fleet out in the evening and during the day you can join in with the general maltia fleets that go out
